liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hi-Heel Sneakers** (1 review): Pig and Jerry alternate verses on the song Hi-Heel Sneakers [15]
- **High Time** (1 review): High Time is described as otherworldly, recorded shortly after the moon landing [15]
- **Caution (Do Not Stop On Tracks)** (1 review): Dark Star, The Other One, and Caution are described as unique and impressive [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Hi-Heel Sneakers**: back after 137 archived shows (988 days); rare: 5 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-08-03.137368.sbd.eaton.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 11 songs; 108 min; rated 4.14/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1969-08-03.sbd.miller.30652.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 11 songs; 102 min; rated 4.55/5 by 22 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording fluctuates and is quiet initially, but improves significantly during the Dark Star performance; Saxophone is slightly hard to hear at first, but the violin is also audible [5][13]
- **gd1969-08-03.137365.sbd.miller.eaton.flac24**: soundboard; 11 songs; 108 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [2]

## Around the show

- Guest musicians David LaFlamme on violin and Charles Lloyd on saxophone joined the band [4]
- Blissful interplay occurs between Jerry and the saxophone player during the song [5]
- Free jazz saxophone and violin are easily incorporated into the band's music [7]
- Violin sounds like it is from the hills of Kentucky, adding an interesting touch [9]
- Guest musicians outperform the horn players from the 1973 tour and the 1990s saxophonist [6]
- The 1973 horn players were tame and flat, unlike this performance [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-08-03.137368.sbd.eaton.miller.flac16**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Reel Master (10" 1/2 track 15ips) [1]. Also: Source is the soundboard recording gd1969-08-03.137368.sbd.eaton.miller.flac16 [1]
- **gd1969-08-03.sbd.miller.30652.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat [3]
- **gd1969-08-03.137365.sbd.miller.eaton.flac24**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Reel Master (10" 1/2 track 15ips) [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by playlandatthebeach: [Family Dog at the Great Highway](https://mksgrist.wixsite.com/playlandatthebeach/family-dog) [17]
- Poster by playlandatthebeach: [Family Dog at the Great Highway](https://mksgrist.wixsite.com/playlandatthebeach/family-dog) [18]
- Fan art by playlandatthebeach: [Family Dog at the Great Highway](https://mksgrist.wixsite.com/playlandatthebeach/family-dog) [19]
